info.title: DNSY REST API
info.description: Management API of the DNSY DNS server. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json.

post.summary: Create the first admin with the one-time code printed at startup.
Log in with username and password; sets the session and CSRF cookies.
End the current session and clear the cookies.

put.summary: Change the caller's password. Ends all sessions and starts a new one for this client.

get.summary: List the caller's tokens; admins see everyone's.

post.summary: Create a token for the caller. Needs a session, so a token cannot mint tokens.

201.description: Created; the secret is in this response only

403.description: Not a session, or a scope the role does not allow

delete.summary: Revoke a token (own tokens; admins any).
Delete a user. Their tokens and sessions go with them.

patch.summary: Change a user's role and/or reset the password.

get.summary: Get a zone, with its `load_error` and an `ETag`.

put.summary: Replace a zone's settings and records. The DNSSEC policy is kept; the serial is bumped.

delete.summary: Delete a zone and its file.

get.summary: Download the zone as a BIND master file.
List records of a zone (paged). The SOA is part of the zone detail, not listed here.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Only this owner name (relative or absolute).

post.summary: Add a record. The SOA serial is bumped.

ETag.description: Validator of the zone after the write

422.description: Invalid name, rdata or TTL, or a CNAME conflict

put.summary: Replace a record. The id changes when name, type or value change. The serial is bumped.

ETag.description: Validator of the zone after the write

422.description: Invalid name, rdata or TTL, a CNAME conflict, or the last apex NS removed

delete.summary: Delete a record. The apex keeps at least one NS record. The serial is bumped.

ETag.description: Validator of the zone after the write

422.description: The last apex NS record cannot be removed

get.summary: The process can serve requests (the database answers).

code.description: The one-time code printed to stderr at startup.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds; omit for a token that does not expire.

scopes.description: Must be allowed by the caller's role.

CreatedToken.description: The only response that contains the token secret.

token.description: The secret. Store it now; it cannot be retrieved again.

detail.description: Explanation specific to this occurrence. Never contains secrets.

retry_after_secs.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (only on 429).

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

RecordInput.description: A record as written by a client.

name.description: `@`, a name relative to the zone, or an absolute name ending in a dot.

ttl.description: Seconds; defaults to the zone default TTL.

type.description: A, AAAA, NS, CNAME, PTR, MX, TXT, SRV or CAA.

total.description: Records matching the filters, across all pages.

id.description: Stable id: hash of owner name, type and value.

SoaBody.description: The SOA record of a zone.

rname.description: Responsible mailbox, as a domain name.

serial.description: Initial serial on create (default 1). Ignored on replace: every write bumps the serial.

ttl.description: TTL of the SOA record; defaults to the zone default TTL.

TokenInfo.description: Token metadata. The secret is never part of it.

UpdateUser.description: Fields to change; absent fields stay as they are.

password.description: Reset the password (at least 8 characters); ends all of the user's sessions.

role.description: Changing the role ends all of the user's sessions.

UserInfo.description: A user account. Never carries password material.

ZoneBody.description: Settings and records of a zone, for create and replace.

records.description: Must contain at least one NS record at the apex.

ZoneDetail.description: A zone with its SOA (no records; see `/zones/{name}/records`).

load_error.description: Why the zone file on disk is not being served, if its latest version is invalid.
